premises.text: At conferences and crowded venues people fail to identify who nearby is worth meeting
premises.evidence_span: only to stand by the conference bar eating peanuts, wondering who you should talk to next

premises.text: Sonar finds people at a venue, aggregates public profile data, and ranks who is most relevant
premises.evidence_span: Sonar scours the web for people at this venue, then aggregates and synthesizes publicly available profile data, and then sorts the room by who's most relevant to you

premises.text: One click shows shared connections and interests plus a bio, enabling a hyper-targeted introduction with social proof
premises.evidence_span: you're never more than one click away from a hyper-targeted introduction to the person you want to meet

premises.text: The app is a hyperlocal medium for telling people present who you are and what you are looking for
premises.evidence_span: Sonar's laser-focused on giving you a way to tell people here that you're here and this is what you're about

value.text: Uncover hidden connections so you can meet the right person in the room instead of leaving it to chance
value.evidence_span: uncovers the hidden connections that you share with everyone else in this room

secondary_value.text: Save time and money as a hyperlocal social CRM
secondary_value.evidence_span: hyperlocal social CRM tool that is going to save you time and money

causal_links.evidence_span: wondering who you should talk to next
bottled the thousands of connections that I definitely would have missed
digital local self-expression that you can use to share what you're proud of and what you're looking for

notes: 'Democratize the meatspace' treated as vision framing, not a premise (v1.3.2 §4.1(4)). Three-click demo steps folded into ranking+intro capability. No explicit monetization module stated beyond CRM benefit. Singleton D1 and D3 retained: venue connection-failure assumption and self-expression positioning are separately revisable from the ranking engine.
